items.title: 动词 + 介词的固定搭配
items.brief: 介词由宾语类型决定，及物动词不加介词

concept.summary: 动词 + 介词的搭配整条记忆，判断依据是介词后宾语的类型：接受者或对象用 to，受益者、原因、交换用 for，话题与领域用 on/about/in，伴随与工具用 with。同一动词换介词即换义：agree with 接人，agree to 接提议，agree on 接条款。另有一类动词本身就及物，汉语里的介词在英语中不能出现。

sections.p: 先把空格后的名词归类，再选介词。人、机构、对象归 to；事情、原因、代价归 for；话题、领域归 on/in/about。三类分工稳定，覆盖绝大多数高频搭配。
bullets: 接受者用 to：apologize to sb., explain sth. to sb., complain to sb.
原因与交换用 for：apologize for sth., thank sb. for sth., pay for sth.
话题与影响用 on：congratulate sb. on sth., spend money on sth., comment on sth.
伴随与工具用 with：agree with sb., compare A with B, deal with sth.

sections.h: 同一动词换介词即换义
sections.p: agree、care、hear 这三个动词的介词变化最常考，且义项差别明显，必须成组记。
bullets: agree with sb. 同意某人；agree to a plan 同意计划；agree on a price 就价格达成一致
care about 关心、在乎；care for 照顾、喜欢（多用于否定与疑问）
hear about 听说（间接得知）；hear from sb. 收到某人来信；hear of 听说过

sections.p: discuss、marry、enter、reach、contact、answer、attend 在英语中直接带宾语。汉语说“讨论关于…”“和…结婚”“进入…”，逐字翻译就会多出介词，这是写作中最高频的搭配错误。
bullets: discuss the plan；× discuss about the plan
marry sb.；× marry with sb.
enter the room / reach the station / contact the manager / attend the meeting
介词后接动词一律用动名词：insist on doing, succeed in doing

examples.en: She apologized to the guests for the delay.
examples.zh: 她为延误向客人道了歉。
examples.note: 道歉对象由 to 引出，原因由 for 引出，两个介词分工不同。

examples.en: We finally agreed on a price with the seller.
examples.zh: 我们最终和卖家谈定了价格。
examples.note: agree on 后接达成一致的具体条款或价格。

examples.en: She apologized the guests for the delay.
examples.zh: 她为延误向客人道了歉。
examples.note: apologize 不及物，道歉对象必须由 to 引出，应改为 apologized to the guests。

examples.en: He insisted on paying for the meal.
examples.zh: 他坚持付饭钱。
examples.note: insist on 的 on 是介词，后接动名词 paying。

examples.en: They discussed about the new policy for two hours.
examples.zh: 他们讨论新政策讨论了两个小时。
examples.note: discuss 是及物动词，直接带宾语，应改为 discussed the new policy。

examples.en: The success of the project depends on careful planning.
examples.zh: 项目的成功取决于周密的计划。
examples.note: depend on 的 on 不可省，后接名词短语。

examples.en: She married with a doctor from Canada.
examples.zh: 她嫁给了一位来自加拿大的医生。
examples.note: marry 是及物动词，直接接宾语，应改为 married a doctor。

examples.en: Please explain the rule to the new students.
examples.zh: 请把这条规则向新生解释一下。
examples.note: explain 的宾语是被解释的内容，接受者由 to 引出。

pitfalls.right: He explained the problem to me.
pitfalls.why: explain 的宾语只能是“被解释的内容”，接受者必须由介词 to 引出，不能构成双宾语。
discuss 本身及物，about 只出现在名词 discussion 之后：a discussion about the budget。

pitfalls.wrong: She apologized the teacher for being late.
pitfalls.right: She apologized to the teacher for being late.
pitfalls.why: apologize 是不及物动词，道歉对象必须由 to 引出，否则句子没有宾语落点。

contrast.withTitle: 形容词 + 介词的固定搭配
contrast.diff: 动词的介词由动作指向决定（对人是 to、为事是 for）；形容词的介词由所评价的性质与对象关系决定。

concept.mnemonic: 人用 to，事用 for，话题用 on；discuss、marry、enter 后面不加介词。

core: agree with 人 / agree to 提议 / agree on 条款
apologize to sb. for sth.；thank sb. for sth.；congratulate sb. on sth.
insist on、depend on、succeed in 后接动名词
explain sth. to sb.，不能 explain sb. sth.
discuss / marry / enter / reach / contact 直接带宾语
review.trigger: 看到动词后面想加介词 → 先问宾语是人还是事 → 再查该动词是否本来就及物

quickCheck.q: agree with 与 agree to 的宾语分别是什么？
quickCheck.a: with 接人，to 接提议、计划。
不能，用 explain sth. to sb.。

quickCheck.q: discuss 后面要加 about 吗？

drills.stem: The airline ___ the passengers for the long delay.
drills.answer: apologized to
drills.explain: 空格后是道歉的对象 the passengers，必须由介词 to 引出；原因 for the long delay 已在后面出现。
drills.trap: apologized for 后面的宾语应是事而不是人，选它会与后面的 for the long delay 重复。

drills.stem: She insisted on ___ (take) the night train to save time.
drills.answer: taking
drills.hint: on 在这里是什么词性？
drills.explain: insist on 的 on 是介词，介词后的动词必须用动名词，故填 taking。

drills.stem: They discussed about the new budget for over two hours.
drills.answer: They discussed the new budget for over two hours.
accept: They discussed the new budget for over two hours.
drills.explain: discuss 是及物动词，直接带宾语，about 只用于名词 discussion 之后。

drills.stem: Nobody could ___ why the machine had stopped.
drills.answer: explain to us
drills.explain: 接受者必须由介词 to 引出，构成 explain sth. to sb.；explain 不能带双宾语。
drills.trap: explain us 是把汉语“给我们解释”逐字译成双宾语，英语中 explain 不允许这种结构。

drills.stem: 他为自己的迟到向老师道了歉。
drills.answer: He apologized to the teacher for being late.
drills.explain: apologize to sb. for sth. 是固定结构：对象用 to，原因用 for，两个介词都不能省。

drills.stem: 把下列词组连成一句通顺的话。
drills.answer: The result depends on how carefully we plan.
drills.explain: depend on 的 on 后接宾语从句，从句用陈述语序 how carefully we plan。

items.title: 形容词 + 介词的固定搭配
items.brief: 对人 to、对事 for、领域 at/in、情绪 of

concept.summary: 形容词后的介词由“评价对象与参照点”决定：态度指向人用 to，益处与用途指向事物用 for，能力与领域用 at/in，情绪触发与所属内容用 of/about，伴随与关系用 with。同一形容词换介词就换评价角度，因此不能按汉语直译，只能整条记搭配。介词后接动词一律用动名词。

sections.h: 四类关系对应四组介词
sections.p: 先给空格后的名词归类，再选介词。对象是人、事物、领域还是情绪来源，决定了唯一答案。
bullets: 对人：be kind / polite / friendly / rude / good to sb.
对事的益处：be good / bad / useful / harmful for sth.
领域与能力：be good / skillful / expert / poor at sth.；be interested / involved in sth.
情绪与所属：be proud / afraid / fond / capable / aware of sth.；be worried / curious / certain about sth.

sections.p: 以下搭配在语法填空与写作中出现频率最高，其中 with 组最容易被误换成 to 或 for。
bullets: be satisfied with / familiar with / busy with / strict with sb. / popular with
be ready for / responsible for / famous for / suitable for / late for
be surprised at / good at / skilled at / disappointed at sth.
be different from / safe from / far from

sections.p: 一是介词后误用动词原形，二是把固定介词整个省掉。前者是词形问题，后者是结构问题，改错时都要检查。
bullets: be good at swimming；× be good at swim
I am interested in music；× I am interested music
She is afraid of dogs；× She is afraid dogs

examples.en: She is very kind to her new neighbours.
examples.zh: 她对新邻居很友善。
examples.note: 态度指向人，用 to。

examples.en: Regular exercise is good for your heart.
examples.zh: 经常锻炼对你的心脏有好处。
examples.note: 益处指向事物，用 for。

examples.en: He is good at solving practical problems.
examples.zh: 他擅长解决实际问题。
examples.note: 能力指向领域，用 at，后接动名词。

examples.en: He is good in solving practical problems.
examples.zh: 他擅长解决实际问题。
examples.note: 表“擅长”的固定介词是 at，in 不能与 good 构成这一搭配。

examples.en: The teacher is strict with us but fair.
examples.zh: 老师对我们严格但公平。
examples.note: strict 的对象是人，固定用 with。

examples.en: I am interested to modern architecture.
examples.zh: 我对现代建筑感兴趣。
examples.note: interested 的固定介词是 in，且不能换成 to。

examples.en: We are all responsible for keeping the classroom clean.
examples.zh: 我们都有责任保持教室清洁。
examples.note: responsible for 后接所负责的事情，用动名词。

examples.en: She is very proud for her son.
examples.zh: 她为儿子感到骄傲。
examples.note: proud 的固定介词是 of，for 表受益或目的，不能表示骄傲的对象。

pitfalls.wrong: He is good in English grammar.
pitfalls.right: He is good at English grammar.
pitfalls.why: 表“在某学科或技能上有能力”的固定介词是 at；in 只与 field、area 这类表示范围的名词搭配，不能与 good 构成“擅长”义。
interested 的固定介词是 in，删掉后形容词与宾语之间没有连接成分。

pitfalls.wrong: She is proud for her students.
pitfalls.right: She is proud of her students.
pitfalls.why: 骄傲这种情绪由 of 引出触发对象；for 表受益者或目的，指向的是“为谁而做”。

contrast.withTitle: 同一形容词搭配不同介词的语义差异
contrast.diff: 本点给出每个形容词的默认介词；该点处理 good、sensitive、anxious 等词换介词后评价角度改变的三种情况。

concept.mnemonic: 对人 to，对事 for，领域 at/in，情绪 of/about，伴随 with。

core: 对人：be kind / polite / rude / good to sb.
对事：be good / useful / harmful for sth.
领域：be good at, be interested in, be expert at
情绪与所属：be proud of, be afraid of, be worried about, be satisfied with
介词后接动词用动名词：be good at doing
review.trigger: 看到形容词后面要接名词 → 先判对象是人、事、领域还是情绪来源 → 再选 to/for/at/of/about/with

quickCheck.q: be good at 与 be good for 的区别？
quickCheck.a: at 表擅长某领域，for 表对…有益。

quickCheck.q: be proud 后接什么介词？
be interested 后面能省 in 吗？
quickCheck.a: 不能，in 是固定搭配的一部分。

drills.stem: Moderate exercise is especially good ___ people who sit at a desk all day.
drills.answer: for
drills.explain: 此处评价的是“对某类人有好处”，属于益处与用途，固定用 good for。
drills.trap: good to 表“对某人态度好”，主语必须是人；用来说运动对人好，语义错位。

drills.stem: She has always been fond ___ old maps.
drills.answer: of
drills.hint: 这个介词与 proud、afraid 后面的介词相同。
drills.explain: be fond of 表示“喜爱”，of 引出喜爱的对象，属固定搭配。

drills.stem: My brother is very good in mathematics.
drills.answer: My brother is very good at mathematics.
accept: My brother is very good at mathematics.
drills.explain: 表“擅长某学科”的固定搭配是 be good at，in 不能替换 at。

drills.stem: The new employee is still not familiar ___ the filing system.
drills.answer: with
drills.explain: 主语是人、宾语是被熟悉的事物时，用 be familiar with；familiar to 的主语必须是被熟悉的事物。
drills.trap: familiar to 的结构是“某物 is familiar to 某人”，主语与宾语的位置刚好相反，用在本句会造成主宾颠倒。

drills.stem: 我们为学校的变化感到骄傲。
drills.answer: We are proud of the changes in our school.
drills.explain: proud 的固定介词是 of，of 引出骄傲的对象；for 表受益，about 表话题，都不能替换。

drills.stem: 把下列词组连成一句通顺的话。
drills.answer: She is very strict with her students.
drills.explain: strict 的对象是人，固定用 with；谓语 is 与单数主语 She 一致。

items.title: 名词 + 介词的固定搭配
items.brief: 名词的介词多继承同源动词或形容词

concept.summary: 名词后的介词通常继承同源动词或形容词的搭配：depend on → dependence on，interested in → interest in，succeed in → success in。没有同源词可依时按语义关系定：to 引出对象与方向，for 引出目的、原因与交换，in 引出领域，of 引出所属与内容，on 引出话题与影响。判定时先还原同源词，再套介词。

sections.p: 这是最可靠的一条路径：先把名词还原成动词或形容词，介词就跟着原词走，不必另记。
bullets: depend on → dependence on；rely on → reliance on
succeed in → success in；participate in → participation in
interested in → interest in；satisfied with → satisfaction with
contribute to → contribution to；object to → objection to

sections.h: to 与 for 的分工
sections.p: to 引出“针对谁、通向什么”的对象关系；for 引出“为了什么、因为什么、换什么”。这两组最容易混，判断时问一句“这个名词指向对象还是指向目的”。
bullets: 对象与方向用 to：the key to the door, the answer to the question, an introduction to the topic, damage to the environment
目的与原因用 for：the reason for the delay, a cure for the disease, respect for the law, a talent for music

sections.p: 四个介词各管一类关系，配常见名词整组记。
bullets: in 表领域：an expert in genetics, a rise in prices, difficulty in doing sth.
of 表所属与内容：the cause of the fire, an advantage of the plan, a lack of water
with 表伴随与关系：a talk with the manager, contact with local schools
on 表话题与影响：a lecture on climate, an effect on children, an attack on the proposal

examples.en: There has been a sharp rise in house prices.
examples.zh: 房价大幅上涨。
examples.note: rise 表“上涨的幅度”，领域由 in 引出。

examples.en: The key to the problem lies in communication.
examples.zh: 解决问题的关键在于沟通。
examples.note: key 后固定用 to，引出所针对的问题。

examples.en: There has been a sharp rise of house prices.
examples.zh: 房价大幅上涨。
examples.note: rise 的固定介词是 in，of 不能表示上涨所涉及的领域。

examples.en: His contribution to the project was widely recognized.
examples.zh: 他对项目的贡献得到了广泛认可。
examples.note: contribution 继承动词 contribute to 的介词。

examples.en: She has a real talent for languages.
examples.zh: 她很有语言天赋。
examples.note: talent 后固定用 for，引出天赋所在的方面。

examples.en: She has a real talent of languages.
examples.zh: 她很有语言天赋。
examples.note: talent 的固定介词是 for，of 只能表所属，不能引出天赋所在的方面。

examples.en: The police are still investigating the cause of the fire.
examples.zh: 警方仍在调查起火原因。
examples.note: cause 与结果之间是所属关系，用 of。

examples.en: We discussed the reason of the delay.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了延误的原因。
examples.note: reason 的固定介词是 for，应改为 the reason for the delay。

pitfalls.wrong: There is no easy answer of this question.
pitfalls.right: There is no easy answer to this question.
pitfalls.why: answer 表“针对某问题的解答”，对象关系由 to 引出；of 只表示所属，不能指向问题。

pitfalls.wrong: He has a strong interest of modern art.
pitfalls.right: He has a strong interest in modern art.
pitfalls.why: interest 继承形容词 interested 的介词 in，of 无法表达“兴趣所在领域”。

pitfalls.wrong: The company's dependence of oil imports is risky.
pitfalls.right: The company's dependence on oil imports is risky.
pitfalls.why: dependence 继承动词 depend 的介词 on，介词不随词性改变而更换。

contrast.withTitle: 同一形容词搭配不同介词的语义差异
contrast.diff: 名词的介词多由同源动词或形容词继承，答案是唯一的；形容词组内部换介词则是改变评价角度，两组都要看语义指向。

concept.mnemonic: 先找同源词，介词跟着走；key、answer 用 to，reason、cure 用 for。

core: 名词介词继承同源词：dependence on, interest in, success in, contribution to
to：key, answer, introduction, damage, contribution
for：reason, cure, respect, talent, admiration
in：rise, expert, difficulty, participation
of：cause, advantage, lack；on：lecture, effect, attack
review.trigger: 看到名词后要接介词 → 先还原它的同源动词或形容词 → 再套用那条搭配

quickCheck.q: the key ___ the door 用什么介词？
rise 后面接 in 还是 of？

drills.stem: The doctors could find no cure ___ the rare disease.
drills.answer: for
drills.explain: cure 后固定用 for，引出所针对的疾病，与 reason for 属同一类“目的与针对”关系。
drills.trap: to 是强干扰项，因为 answer、key 都用 to；但 cure 的固定介词是 for。

drills.stem: There has been a steady rise ___ food prices this year.
drills.answer: in
drills.hint: 这个名词表示“上涨的幅度”，需要引出涉及的领域。
drills.explain: a rise in sth. 是固定搭配，in 引出上涨所涉及的领域；of 只表所属。

drills.stem: There is no simple answer of that question.
drills.answer: There is no simple answer to that question.
accept: There is no simple answer to that question.
drills.explain: answer 表“针对某问题的解答”，对象由 to 引出，不能换成表所属的 of。

drills.stem: Her contribution ___ the team was far greater than people realized.
drills.answer: to
drills.explain: contribution 继承动词 contribute to 的介词，to 引出贡献的对象。
drills.trap: for 表目的或受益，contribution for 不是固定搭配；of 只表所属，无法指明贡献给了谁。

drills.stem: 大雨是延误的原因。
drills.answer: The heavy rain was the reason for the delay.
drills.explain: reason 后固定用 for，引出原因所解释的那件事；of 表所属，to 表方向，都不能替换。

drills.stem: 把下列词组连成一句通顺的话。
drills.answer: The book gives a brief introduction to modern physics.
drills.explain: introduction to 是固定搭配，to 引出介绍所指向的学科。

items.title: 同一形容词搭配不同介词的语义差异
items.brief: 换介词即换评价角度，先定指向再选词

concept.summary: 同一形容词配不同介词，改变的是“评价指向”：at 指向具体领域或触发点，for 指向受益者或目的，to 指向态度对象或外界刺激，about 指向所谈论、所忌讳或所担忧的内容。判断顺序是先确定句子要表达哪一种指向，再选介词；先选介词再猜语义必然出错。

sections.p: 三句的主语类型不同，介词随之不同：主语是人说能力，主语是事物说益处，主语是人说待人态度。
bullets: at 表能力领域：She is good at maths. / He is good at explaining difficult ideas.
for 表受益对象：Walking is good for your knees. / Tourism is good for the local economy.
to 表待人态度，可与 kind 互换：The manager is good to new employees.

sections.p: to 是被动感受性，指对外界刺激或变化有反应；about 是主动介意，指不愿被人提及的话题。同一人可以对光敏感（to），同时对体重介意（about）。
bullets: to：This camera is sensitive to changes in light. / She is sensitive to criticism.
about：He is rather sensitive about his height. / She is sensitive about money.
对比：Journalists should be sensitive to the mood of the crowd. / He is sensitive about his accent.

sections.p: about 引出担忧的具体对象，指向可能发生的不利结果；for 引出渴望得到的东西，或为某人的安危担心。判定看后面的名词是“怕发生的事”还是“想得到的东西”。
bullets: about：Parents are anxious about their children's safety. / She is anxious about the exam.
for：She is anxious for a chance to prove herself. / He is anxious for a reply.
同类对照：be angry with sb. / angry at sth.；be sorry for doing sth. / sorry about sth.

examples.en: She is good at explaining difficult ideas.
examples.zh: 她擅长解释复杂的概念。
examples.note: at 指向能力所及的领域，后接动名词。

examples.en: Walking is good for your knees.
examples.zh: 走路对你的膝盖有好处。
examples.note: for 指向受益对象，主语是事物。

examples.en: The manager is always good to new employees.
examples.zh: 经理对新员工总是很好。
examples.note: to 指向待人态度，可与 kind to 互换。

examples.en: Vegetables are good at your health.
examples.zh: 蔬菜对你的健康有好处。
examples.note: at 表能力领域，不能引出受益对象，应改为 good for your health。

examples.en: He is rather sensitive about his height.
examples.zh: 他对自己的身高比较介意。
examples.note: about 指向不愿被提及的话题，与 to 的“对刺激有反应”分工不同。

examples.en: He is very sensitive about bright light.
examples.zh: 他对强光很敏感。
examples.note: 强光属于外界刺激，应用 sensitive to；about 表“介意某话题”。

examples.en: Parents are naturally anxious about their children's safety.
examples.zh: 父母自然会担心孩子的安全。
examples.note: about 引出担忧的具体对象。

examples.en: She is anxious for a chance to prove herself.
examples.zh: 她渴望有机会证明自己。
examples.note: for 引出渴望得到的东西。

pitfalls.wrong: Fresh fruit is good at your skin.
pitfalls.right: Fresh fruit is good for your skin.
pitfalls.why: at 指向“能力所及的领域”，for 指向受益对象；营养对皮肤有益属于后者。

pitfalls.wrong: He is sensitive about bright light.
pitfalls.right: He is sensitive to bright light.
pitfalls.why: to 引出引起反应的外界刺激，about 引出在意、忌讳的话题，两者指向不同。

pitfalls.wrong: She is anxious for the coming exam.
pitfalls.right: She is anxious about the coming exam.
pitfalls.why: about 引出担忧的具体对象；for 表示渴望得到某物，与“担心考试”的语义冲突。

contrast.withTitle: 形容词 + 介词的固定搭配
contrast.diff: 该点给出每个形容词的默认介词；本点处理同一形容词因介词不同而改变评价指向的情况，答案由语义指向决定。

concept.mnemonic: at 领域，for 受益，to 态度；to 感受，about 忌讳；about 担忧，for 渴望。

core: good at 擅长 / good for 有益 / good to 待人好
sensitive to 对刺激有反应 / sensitive about 对话题介意
anxious about 担忧具体的事 / anxious for 渴望得到
判定顺序：先定评价指向，再选介词
同类对照：angry with sb. / angry at sth.
review.trigger: 看到 good、sensitive、anxious 后面跟介词 → 先问指向是“领域、受益、态度”还是“刺激、话题、担忧”

quickCheck.q: good at 与 good for 各表什么？
quickCheck.a: at 表擅长某领域，for 表对…有益。

quickCheck.q: anxious for 与 anxious about 的区别？
quickCheck.a: for 表渴望得到，about 表为某事担忧。

drills.stem: This kind of low-impact exercise is especially good ___ people who sit all day.
drills.answer: for
drills.explain: 句子评价的是运动对某类人的益处，for 引出受益对象。
drills.trap: at 指向能力领域，需要人与“擅长”的语义，本句主语是运动而不是人。

drills.stem: He never talks about his childhood; he is still sensitive ___ it.
drills.answer: about
drills.hint: 这里说的是“不愿被提及”，不是“对外界刺激有反应”。
drills.explain: sensitive about 表示对某话题介意、不愿触及，与前半句“从不谈起”呼应。

drills.stem: She is anxious for the results of the medical test.
drills.answer: She is anxious about the results of the medical test.
accept: She is anxious about the results of the medical test.
drills.explain: 此处是为检查结果担忧，about 引出担忧对象；anxious for 表示渴望得到，与语境不符。

drills.stem: The novel is remarkably sensitive ___ the mood of the 1930s.
drills.answer: to
drills.explain: 此处指作品对外界氛围有细腻感受力，属于“对刺激有反应”，用 sensitive to。
drills.trap: about 表“介意某话题”，主语必须是有意识的人，不能用于作品对时代氛围的感受力。

drills.stem: 他对自己的口音很敏感。
drills.answer: He is very sensitive about his accent.
drills.explain: 口音是本人介意、不愿被提及的话题，用 sensitive about；to 用于外界刺激引起的反应。

drills.stem: 把下列词组连成一句通顺的话。
drills.answer: Fresh vegetables are good for your health.
drills.explain: 主语是事物，评价的是益处，用 good for；谓语 are 与复数主语一致。

items.title: 介词短语的固定表达
items.brief: 冠词与单复数都已固定，整体调用

concept.summary: 固定介词短语是已经词汇化的整体，内部形式不能按语法推导：该有冠词的不能省（in the end, at the moment），不该有的不能加（at home, by hand, in fact），单复数也已固定（make friends with, take part in）。判断方法是把它当作一个词条整体调用，只分析它在句中作状语还是作定语，不改内部形式。

sections.p: 表活动、方式、状态的介词短语通常不带冠词，因为名词已从“具体事物”转为“抽象活动”。这类短语是写作中的固定块，加冠词即错。
bullets: at home / at school / at work / at night / at noon / at sea
by hand / by bus / by mistake / by chance / by heart
in fact / in danger / in trouble / in public / on time / on foot / on purpose

sections.p: 另一批短语的冠词是词条的一部分，删掉后短语不成立或意义改变。两组要成对记，不能互相类推。
bullets: in the end / at the moment / on the whole / in the way / by the way
all of a sudden / as a result / in a hurry / on the other hand
对比：in front of 在…前面（外部）／ in the front of 在…前部（内部）

sections.h: 形式固定的动宾型短语
sections.p: 以“动词 + 名词 + 介词”构成的固定搭配，名词的冠词与单复数都已锁定，改一个字母就换了一个词条。go to school 与 go to the school 的区别也属这一类：前者表活动，后者指具体建筑。
bullets: make friends with / take part in / make use of / pay attention to / take care of
have access to / make sense / lose heart / keep in touch with
go to school 上学 ／ go to the school 去那所学校

examples.en: She goes to school by bike every morning.
examples.zh: 她每天早上骑自行车上学。
examples.note: go to school 表“上学”这一活动，by bike 表交通方式，两处都用零冠词。

examples.en: In the end, we decided to stay at home.
examples.zh: 最后我们决定待在家里。
examples.note: in the end 的冠词是词条的一部分，不能省。

examples.en: In end, we decided to stay at home.
examples.zh: 最后我们决定待在家里。
examples.note: in the end 必须带定冠词，删掉后短语不成立。

examples.en: He finished the model boat by hand.
examples.zh: 他手工完成了这条模型船。
examples.note: by hand 表方式，是零冠词固定短语。

examples.en: He finished the model boat by the hand.
examples.zh: 他手工完成了这条模型船。
examples.note: by hand 为零冠词短语，加上 the 后变成具体的“那只手”，语义与结构都不对。

examples.en: The two boys soon made friends with each other.
examples.zh: 两个男孩很快成了朋友。
examples.note: make friends with 的 friends 固定为复数。

examples.en: The two boys soon made friend with each other.
examples.zh: 两个男孩很快成了朋友。
examples.note: make friends with 形式固定，friend 必须用复数 friends。

examples.en: As a result, the meeting was put off.
examples.zh: 结果，会议被推迟了。
examples.note: as a result 是不定冠词固定短语，a 不能省也不能换成 the。

pitfalls.wrong: In the fact, nobody knew the answer.
pitfalls.right: In fact, nobody knew the answer.
pitfalls.why: in fact 是零冠词固定短语，fact 前不加 the；加了 the 就变成特指某一事实，短语不再成立。

pitfalls.wrong: She went to the school by the bus.
pitfalls.right: She went to school by bus.
pitfalls.why: by + 交通工具为零冠词结构；go to school 表“上学”这一活动时不加冠词，加了 the 就指具体的学校建筑。

pitfalls.wrong: We should make friend with the new students.
pitfalls.right: We should make friends with the new students.
pitfalls.why: make friends with 的词条形式固定为复数 friends，单数形式不存在。

contrast.diff: 该点从冠词系统讲零冠词与定冠词的取舍规则；本点把整个介词短语当作一个词条，连同介词、冠词、单复数一起记。

concept.mnemonic: 时间地点常裸奔，in the end 要戴帽；friend 变 friends，part 不加 s。

core: 零冠词：at home/school/work/night, by hand/bus/mistake, in fact/danger, on time/foot
带冠词：in the end, at the moment, on the whole, in a hurry, as a result
in front of 在…前面（外部）／ in the front of 在…前部（内部）
动宾型固定：make friends with, take part in, make use of, pay attention to
go to school 上学 ／ go to the school 去那所学校
review.trigger: 看到介词 + 名词的固定组合 → 直接调用整条短语，再核对冠词与单复数是否与原形一致

quickCheck.q: in the end 能省掉 the 吗？
make friends with 的 friend 用单数还是复数？
by bus 与 by the bus 哪个对？

drills.stem: ___ , the project was completed two weeks ahead of schedule.
drills.answer: In the end
drills.explain: in the end 表示“最终”，冠词 the 是词条的固定成分，可单独作句首状语。
drills.trap: At the end 后面必须接 of 短语说明“在…的末尾”，不能单独作状语，也不能表示“最终”。

drills.stem: The village can only be reached ___ foot.
drills.answer: on
drills.hint: 这个短语表示交通方式，与 by bus 属同一类，但介词不同。
drills.explain: on foot 表示“步行”，是零冠词固定短语；交通方式中只有步行用 on，其余多用 by。

drills.stem: He solved the problem by the hand without any help.
drills.answer: He solved the problem by hand without any help.
accept: He solved the problem by hand without any help.
drills.explain: by hand 表示“用手工”，是零冠词固定短语，不能加 the。

drills.stem: She has made ___ with several colleagues since she joined the team.
drills.answer: friends
drills.explain: make friends with 是固定词条，friends 恒为复数且不加冠词。
drills.trap: a friend 单独看成立，但与后面的 with 组合成 make a friend with，不是英语的固定搭配。

drills.stem: 最后我们决定乘公共汽车去博物馆。
drills.answer: In the end, we decided to go to the museum by bus.
drills.explain: in the end 的冠词不可省；by bus 表交通方式，用零冠词结构。

drills.stem: 把下列词组连成一句通顺的话。
drills.answer: We must take part in the debate.
drills.explain: take part in 是固定词条，part 为单数且不加冠词，与 take parts in 相对。
